accepted_findings: The plan binds exactly the six new R20/R21 train, val and test prediction archives and their corresponding score JSON files to both immutable run manifests.
The script checks one-use authority and exact plan/review/source hashes, reserves its immutable receipt before decoding, and rejects a pre-existing report output.
The fixed three-role/two-group loop invokes one allow_pickle=False decode for each archive; there is no retry path, model call, source-cache read or checkpoint load.
Saved IDs, labels, lengths, dimensions, finite truth/static values and positive masses are checked against frozen source-qualified rosters; paired truth and static arrays must match exactly.

The script recomputes TASK3 metrics from saved fine/refined predictions using the hash-bound scoring implementation, then checks saved role records and summary JSON with relative and absolute tolerance 1e-12.

Official truth labels remain frozen; predicted stability, numerical qualification, full/cohort and classifiable accuracy conventions, zero denominators and coverage are reconstructed from the saved trajectories.
Terminal 1 s/3 s targets are recomputed using saved train scales and mass-COI-projected saved truth, with exactly the original numerical qualification and true-length masks.
Per-horizon physical RMSE pooling uses genuine point counts; R21-minus-R20 event differences retain complete versus finite paired denominators, missing IDs and unqualified IDs.
Matched classification transitions explicitly distinguish stable, unstable, unresolved and numerical_failure; unqualified predictions are not reported as effective stable/unstable transitions.
Any recomputation mismatch is retained in the report and produces MISMATCH/nonzero exit rather than silent success or fabricated metric values.
boundaries: This approval covers one exact arithmetic-only saved-evidence audit. It does not authorize new predictions, re-fitting, checkpoint inspection, data-source reads or changes to the frozen models.

The audit independently recomputes from saved arrays using the same frozen TASK3 scoring implementation; it is not a second independent implementation of TASK3 scoring or an independent dataset confirmation.
Reviewer verification used metadata and byte hashes only. No prediction archive or checkpoint was decoded and no audit, test, model or scientific operator was executed during this review.
A PASS audit establishes consistency of saved evidence with the frozen scoring contract, not convergence, stability certification or model promotion.
Test remains reporting-only on its historically exposed fixed benchmark; KEEP_BASELINE remains in force and scientific result interpretation follows the arithmetic audit.
